question: Find the third proportional to 16 and 320.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The third proportional (c) to numbers a and b is calculated directly using the formula c = b² ÷ a.

Here, a = 16 and b = 320.

Third proportional = (320 × 320) ÷ 16

Third proportional = 320 × 20 = 6400

**∴ The correct answer is 6400.**
